'''Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark II''' was a suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s. The spacetroopers wore standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], and would then "plug in" to the armored suit that served as a personal assault vehicle. The powered exoskeleton gave the space trooper enhanced strength, and made him into a walking arsenal.

Mark II armor stood over two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and had built in environmental controls, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and [[Magnetic coupler/Legends|magnetic couplers]] for attaching to the hulls of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The suit had an inbuilt [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] with [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion]], [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun]], and [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenades]], a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], and a [[Laser cutter/Legends|laser cutter]]. A launch rack developed by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] could be mounted to the back of the armor, providing a launching platform for [[mini-proton torpedo]]es.
